name: worker-pool
description: One core plus N workers: a roster, owner-authored bindings, and a router that delivers a bound room's work to its worker. Config: SUTANDO_TASK_EVENT_HANDLER_SCRIPT declares this skill's router as the task-event handler the core's watcher arms when a worker is declared and nothing set SUTANDO_TASK_EVENT_HANDLER (env override wins, per skills/MANIFEST.md).
